name: RICCO Industrial Area

queries.query: RICCO Industrial Area Ajmer Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map GIS; Rajasthan RIICO industrial area GIS cadastral parcel map official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Rajasthan Government Rajdharaa, the official RIICO GIS citizen application, RIICO's official site, and the official RIICO ArcGIS web application configuration. Independent locality results place the WUP name in Kishangarh, Ajmer, Rajasthan; those are not treated as cadastral evidence.

registryBasis: RIICO (Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation Limited) is the evidenced local industrial-area custodian for RIICO industrial plots; the Rajasthan Government Rajdharaa citizen portal links the RIICO GIS application. This establishes a local industrial land/map custodian, not a general national agency only.

officialSources.observation: Official public ArcGIS Web AppBuilder viewer; its live configuration was retrieved anonymously.
Viewer configuration identifies portal item 21016cf7305546c8910219a302d46f7a and public GIS services configured for RIICO plot workflows.
Official citizen portal links the RIICO GIS application.
Official RIICO site identifies the corporation and its industrial-area/land-allotment functions.
